items.question: Why do app screens require signing in first?
items.answer: All inventory, lifecycle parts, shopping lists, and preferences belong strictly to your signed-in account. Unauthenticated or expired requests redirect cleanly back here, while valid sessions resume on your last visited app screen.

items.question: How does the AI Receipt Assistant work?
items.answer: Inside the Shopping screen, you can upload a receipt image and analyze it with OpenRouter vision models (with an optional free-models-only toggle) to extract raw text and structured items directly into your shopping list.

items.question: What do QR labels and barcode scanning support?
items.answer: Each item's detail modal lets you generate and print a dedicated item QR label. Scanning a barcode or QR code in Barcode & QR Scan opens the matching item modal immediately, or prefills a new item form if unmatched.

items.question: How do view density, theme switching, and offline mode behave?
items.answer: In Settings, you can switch Light/Dark/System themes, TR/EN locale, Compact/Detailed density, currency, and default units. Stock or form changes made offline are queued in your browser and synced once reconnected.
